Name: RL Overlay
Author: RS Cast
Description: Control your RL Overlay Rocket League overlay from your Stream Deck: score, series, timeouts, overlay visibility, on-screen HUD, team swap and themes, with the live state on your keys.

Actions.Name: Score
Actions.Tooltip: Adds or removes a goal for a team. The key shows the live score.

Actions.Name: Series
Actions.Tooltip: Adds or removes a won game in the series (BO), or resets the series to 0 - 0 (press twice to confirm). The key shows the series.

Actions.Name: Timeout
Actions.Tooltip: Press: take the team's timeout (press again to end the timeout screen). Hold: give it back. Live countdown on the key.

Actions.Name: Overlay visible
Actions.Tooltip: Shows or hides the whole overlay on stream.

Actions.Name: On-screen HUD
Actions.Tooltip: Shows or hides the overlay on top of your game, on your screen (like "Show the HUD on screen" in the panel).

Actions.Name: Swap teams
Actions.Tooltip: Swaps the two teams: names, tags, logos and timeouts.

Actions.Name: Theme
Actions.Tooltip: Applies a theme (the key lights up when it is active), or switches to the next theme.
